_doc: Policy gate for bifrost-shell MCP tools. A: READ + ANALYZE enabled, WRITE + EXECUTE present-but-denied. B: flip enabled:true on WRITE/EXECUTE + fill enforcement bodies (write allowlist; subprocess jail with resource limits, no network, scratch cwd). Pattern: Session O coevolution Policy layer applied to MCP tool execution.

READ.note: Container-bounded reads (no host FS in A); network-dependent READ tools fail at runtime when container has no network — not a policy denial.

ANALYZE.note: ruff + mypy on inline code; no FS or network deps; safest subset.

WRITE.note: Docker-MCP-2-B: enable + fill enforcement (allowlist of writable paths via env var; reject writes outside).

EXECUTE.note: Docker-MCP-2-B: enable + fill enforcement (subprocess jail: resource limits, no network, scratch cwd, timeout already exists).

DELEGATE.note: Network call to leaf via bifrost-delegate MCP. Lower risk than EXECUTE.

COMPUTE.note: 2026-08-04: INERT BY OPERATOR DECISION. The quantum leg was retired 2026-07-11 (operator-signed ceremony), but the tool is deliberately KEPT registered so the capability and its proven SSH-to-Forge pattern are not lost. Sole member: quantum_circuit_test. Re-enable by flipping this flag -- no code change needed.

SANDBOX.note: Arbitrary code, but isolated-by-construction: runs in the k3d `sandbox` namespace which enforces a deny-all NetworkPolicy (no egress) + ResourceQuota + continuous sandbox_monitor.py auto-quarantine (Phases 1-3, proven). Fail-closed: the payload runs only AFTER egress deny-all is confirmed (guards the kube-router reconcile race), and the pod is always deleted. This IS the isolated-execution jail the EXECUTE class lacks -> enabled where EXECUTE is denied. Lower risk than host EXECUTE; mirrors the COMPUTE pattern (isolated, bounded).

READ_FS.note: 2026-08-04 (audit C2/C3): filesystem reads by caller-supplied path, scoped via _sb_resolve. Split out of READ so host-FS reads can be disabled without also disabling the network status tools. READ's old note claimed 'container-bounded reads (no host FS in A)' -- that stopped being true when bifrost-investigate.yaml began mounting three host paths, including sandbox-kubeconfig at /kc.

WEB.note: 2026-10-08 (Ceremony 107, signed John, option b): outbound HTTP to the SearXNG instance for public-web lookups. Split out of READ -- deliberately NOT folded into it -- so third-party egress can be revoked in one move without also disabling kb_search, router_status and router_health. Sole member: web_search. Mirrors the READ_FS split of 2026-08-04. Granted to igor only; leaf was explicitly NOT granted it (John 2026-10-08).
